root_cause: Take 1 read two authored clause joins without any silence, so measured caption cues merged whole sentences and board_retime can't map clauses n3a n3b and n4a n4b to measured cue text.
repair: Add direction in vo_direction.json that asks for a short natural breath after credentials and after citations. Nothing else in the direction, the script, board, claims, sources or renderer changes.
mechanism_change: The read gains two directed breaths at the clause joins instead of running those two sentences through as one phrase each.
expected_visible_result: Measured silence of at least a third of a second at the n3a|n3b and n4a|n4b joins, so each clause has its own measured cue and retiming succeeds.
